description:
Implement the three stub functions in pkix-chain-simple and add integration tests.

BLOCKED BY: Epic PKIX-lwr (path validator) and Epic PKIX-ehn (RustCrypto backends, specifically the DefaultVerifier dispatch wrapper).

Functions to implement:

check_algorithm (pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:321):
  - Compare cert.signature_algorithm.oid against ALLOWED_SIG_ALGS slice
  - Also verify outer signatureAlgorithm == inner TBSCertificate.signature per RFC 5280 §4.1.1.2 (these must be identical; mismatch is a forgery vector)
  - Return Error::AlgorithmNotAllowed { index } on failure

check_extensions (pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:335):
  Leaf cert (is_leaf=true):
    - Walk all extensions; any OID not in ALLOWED_LEAF_EXTENSIONS → Error::UnexpectedExtension
    - If BasicConstraints present and cA=TRUE → Error::LeafIsCA
  Intermediate cert (is_leaf=false):
    - Walk all extensions; any OID not in ALLOWED_INTERMEDIATE_EXTENSIONS → Error::UnexpectedExtension
    - If BasicConstraints absent or cA=FALSE → Error::MissingRequiredExtension
    - If KeyUsage absent or keyCertSign not set → Error::MissingRequiredExtension

RustCryptoVerifier::verify_signature (pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:354):
  - Do not re-implement; delegate to the DefaultVerifier from pkix-path (Epic PKIX-ehn issue 3)
  - RustCryptoVerifier becomes a thin newtype wrapper around DefaultVerifier

Integration tests:
  - Happy path: leaf + 1 intermediate + root anchor (use rcgen or PKITS fixtures)
  - Rejected: chain with 3 intermediates (ChainTooLong)
  - Rejected: cert with ecdsa-with-SHA384 (AlgorithmNotAllowed)
  - Rejected: intermediate with CRLDistributionPoints extension (UnexpectedExtension)
  - Rejected: intermediate missing BasicConstraints (MissingRequiredExtension)
  - Rejected: leaf cert with cA=TRUE (LeafIsCA)
  Test vectors must use external oracle (OpenSSL or rcgen) — never self-derived.

Sub-issues to create:
1. Implement check_algorithm
2. Implement check_extensions (leaf path)
3. Implement check_extensions (intermediate path)
4. Wire RustCryptoVerifier to DefaultVerifier
5. Integration test suite for verify_simple

Acceptance: verify_simple happy path passes with a real chain. All rejection cases tested. Clippy clean.
